订阅链接是日历的只读地址，不用登录。先选所用的日历服务，下面直接列出它的步骤。: A subscription link is a calendar's read-only address, with no sign-in. Pick your calendar service first and its steps are listed right below.
Google 账号的「集成日历」里没有私密地址: The Google account's "Integrate calendar" has no secret address
学校或公司的 Google 账号，管理员可以关掉私密地址。改用个人 Google: On a school or work Google account the administrator can switch the secret address off. Use a personal Google account, or ask the administrator to turn it on.
Google 日历里的外部日历变了，这里很久才跟上: A calendar added to Google from elsewhere changed, and it takes a long time to show here
在 Google 里「通过网址添加」的日历，Google 要 12–24 小时才: Google refreshes calendars added "From URL" only every 12–24 hours. Connect that calendar's original subscription link here directly.
链接发给了别人或贴到了公开的地方: The link was sent to someone or posted somewhere public
在日历里重置私密地址（Google 点「重置」，Outlook 取消发布后重新发: Reset the private address in the calendar (Google: "Reset"; Outlook: unpublish and publish again; iCloud: turn Public Calendar off and on), remove the old one here, and connect the new link.
点「打开设置页」，在左侧「我的日历的设置」里点要接入的日历: Press "Open settings", then under "Settings for my calendars" on the left click the calendar to connect
往下找到「集成日历」，拷贝「iCal 格式的私密地址」（不是「公开地址」）: Scroll to "Integrate calendar" and copy the "Secret address in iCal format" (not the "Public address")
学校或公司的 Google 账号，管理员可能关闭了私密地址，这时「集成日历」里没: On a school or work Google account the administrator may have switched the secret address off, and then "Integrate calendar" does not show it: use a personal account, or ask the administrator to turn it on. Calendars added to Google "From URL" (a school timetable, say) are refreshed by Google only every 12–24 hours; connect such a calendar's original subscription link here and changes arrive sooner. If the secret address leaks, press "Reset" in the same place and the old link stops working at once.
点「打开设置页」，在「共享日历」页的「发布日历」里选要接入的日历，权限选「可以查: Press "Open settings", then on the "Shared calendars" page under "Publish a calendar" choose the calendar, set the permission to "Can view all details" and press "Publish"
拿到链接的人都能看这本日历。泄露了就在同一页点「取消发布」再重新发布，旧链接失效: Anyone with the link can see this calendar. If it leaks, press "Unpublish" on the same page and publish again; the old link stops working.
有的学校或公司关闭了日历发布，这时页面上没有「发布日历」：改用个人日历，或请管理: Some schools and companies switch calendar publishing off, and then the page has no "Publish a calendar": use a personal calendar, or ask the administrator to turn it on. If the link leaks, unpublish and publish again; the old link stops working.
点「打开设置页」，在 iCloud 日历里点要接入的日历旁的共享图标（在 iPh: Press "Open settings", then in iCloud Calendar click the share icon beside the calendar to connect (on an iPhone, the ⓘ in the calendar list)
公开日历的链接任何拿到的人都能看。泄露了就关掉「公开日历」再打开，会生成新链接，: Anyone with a public calendar's link can see it. If it leaks, turn "Public Calendar" off and on again: a new link is made and the old one stops working.
